Run one of the charts the dashboard shows: retention, paywalls, web traffic, installs, countries and
more. 'voidhash analytics charts' lists them.

A time series reads as one number per line: the total of counts and money, the latest value of rates
and stocks. Tables show their first 25 rows. --json has the whole result.

Usage:
  voidhash analytics chart <chart> [flags]

Arguments:
  chart  The chart's id, as 'voidhash analytics charts' lists it

Flags:
      --by <hour|day|week|month>  Bucket width of a time series (default: day)
      --dimension <dimension>     What a chart with dimensions groups by
      --from <day>                First day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of --last)
  -h, --help                      Show help for this command
      --json                      Print the API result as JSON, for scripts
      --last <span>               The complete days before today to report on: a span such as 7d,
                                  4w, 3m or 1y (default: 30d)
      --metric <metric>           What a chart with metrics shows
      --project <project>         Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name
                                  (default: this directory's project, then your default project)
      --timezone <zone>           IANA time zone days are cut in, such as Europe/Prague (default:
                                  UTC)
      --to <day>                  Last day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today; with --from)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash analytics chart mrr_trend --last 90d --by week
  voidhash analytics chart revenue_by_placement
  voidhash analytics chart top_pages --timezone Europe/Prague --json
